name: Host To ATM Acknowledgement V 01
definition: The HostToATMAcknowledgement message is sent by an ATM to a host to acknowledge the receipt of a HostToATMRequest message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

HostToATMAcknowledgement.name: Host To ATM Acknowledgement
HostToATMAcknowledgement.definition: Information related to the acknowledgement from an ATM to contact the ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
